deities: Arudra Kabaleeswarar (Shiva, as a lingam said to carry carvings of 108 Shivalingas)

history.period: Kongu Chola period, 1004-1280 CE (approx. 1000 years; age varies by source, 500-1000 years)
history.summary: This is the ancient Shiva temple in Erode Fort on Eswaran Kovil Street (Erode 638001), with a five-tier Rajagopuram, granite construction and a swayambhu lingam. Local tradition credits a king named Lakshmikanthan and the Kongu Cholas; visitor reviews describe 600-700 years of history and 3 prakarams, and it is administered by the Tamil Nadu HR&CE Department. IDENTITY NOTES: do not confuse with the Kodumudi Magudeswarar temple (seq 2221) - different temple. Uncertainty flags: (1) tamilnadutourisminfo.com claims it is 'the first-ever temple established in Tamil Nadu' and a Paadal Petra Sthalam - both claims appear only on tourism blogs, are unverified, and the Paadal Petra status looks conflated with the Kodumudi Magudeswarar temple; treat as doubtful. (2) velpu.co.in names the main deity 'Thondeeswarar' and says Sage Durvasa installed Shiva in a lying form (Pallikonda Kolam), which conflicts with other sources - verify. (3) epuja.co.in places it in 'Ezhumathur, Erode' while most listings place it in Erode Fort - verify. A Vishnu/Ranganathar shrine stands opposite, noted as a Shaiva-Vaishnava unity feature.

name: Arudra Kabaleeswarar Temple
town_description: Erode is a major city and textile-weaving centre on the Kaveri in western Tamil Nadu, headquarters of Erode district; the temple is in the old Erode Fort quarter, about 550 m from the Erode bus stand.

travel.airport: Salem Airport, about 81 km away (per velpu.co.in).
travel.railway: Erode Junction, about 1.9 km from the temple.
travel.road: Erode Bus Stand about 550 m; local auto-rickshaws and buses from across Erode city.

visitor_information.opening_hours: Conflict across sources: epuja.co.in lists 6:00 am - 11:00 am and 4:00 pm - 8:00 pm; Justdial and WanderBoat list 6:00 am - 8:30 pm; Wanderlog reviews show 6:00 am - 12:00 pm and 4:30 pm - 8:00 pm - verify on visit.
